body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature within weapon range moves, Shoves, or attempts to Grapple you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Spend 1 Combo. The triggering creature stops after its current unit of movement and suffers -1 Fortitude until the end of its turn.

surges.html: If the triggering creature is within weapon range, move it 1 unit or knock it Prone after this Reaction resolves.
After this Reaction resolves, you may suffer -1 Defense until your next turn to gain 1 Combo.
